SMRiaz-SA/Auras-Orbit.desc: Independent Windows desktop and Android media library for CloudStream-compatible extensions, Stremio catalogs, personal watchlists, and integrated playback.

MenaHere/Yuri-Reader.desc: A small fork from Mangayomi to incorporate MALsync because it is fun to do so.

IReaderorg/IReader.desc: Free and open source novel reader for Android and Desktop.

Stiven-Gjekaj/Asabunko.desc: A calm reader for manga, comics, light novels, and web novels, with OPDS, LNReader, Suwayomi, Aidoku, and Paperback sources. iOS, sideloaded.

AtiinLabs/Ito.desc: Open source manga, Anime and Novel viewer for iOS

Nyora-Manga/nyora-ios.desc: Nyora for iOS & iPadOS — free, open-source manga reader; Aidoku-based UI with Nyora cloud sources and sync.
